I am in Amhara and this barley plot is small, owned by my household, so I will try to manage it carefully with what I can afford. For barley here I depend on the rains, not irrigation, and I usually use some fertilizer if I can get it through the cooperative, but not at a very high rate. I will also use some manure from the household, and I do most of the work with family labor to avoid cash expenses. Improved seed is harder for me to get reliably, so I will plant the seed I know.
